card.name: Linking words that open a trailing clause
card.fires_on: Commas and short linking words (especially, including, so, an, using) in general web text, right where a descriptive or explanatory clause is about to follow the main statement.

modes.label: Comma before added detail
modes.description: A comma ending the main clause, just before a descriptive or attribution phrase.
modes.example: China will attempt to land an exploratory craft on the moon for the first time in 2013, state media reported<<,>> according to the telegraph.com.

modes.label: Linking word into purpose or manner
modes.description: Words like especially, including, so or using that introduce a purpose or manner phrase.
modes.example: Gears are mechanical parts with cut teeth designed to fit with teeth on another part<< so>> as to transmit or receive force and motion

modes.label: Verb after a subject
modes.description: A verb or auxiliary following a named subject, before a long description.
modes.example: Impoverished and isolated North Korea<< has>> long invested heavily in its defense programs,

card.writes: No clear theme; the promoted tokens are a mix of odd fragments and symbols.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where a trailing explanatory phrase begins, such as after a comma or 'including'.
